text:
Maria Hu: deploy-bot paused canary — preflight found env-parity issues. Staging cache TTL=600 != prod TTL=3600, secret MODEL_ACCESS_SCOPE differs (staging: 'team:dev' vs prod: 'team:service'), and model pin mismatch (staging -> redwood/ggml:v2.4, prod -> redwood/ggml:v2.2). Rolling forward blocked. Any quick unblocks?

deploy-bot: preflight failed: [ENV_PARITY] MODEL_ACCESS_SCOPE value mismatch; [CACHE_TTL] s3-inference-cache ttl=600 vs 3600; [MODEL_PIN] variant mismatch. See /deploy/checks/3456789123.

Sam Lee: can we just backfill prod secret to match staging for the canary? who owns that secret in vault? :thinking_face:

Raj Patel: prod secret is owned by infra-vault (can't just overwrite to a dev-scoped value). +1 to pin the canary to prod model (v2.2) instead of changing prod secret. TTL change should be scheduled separately.

Kevin O'Connor: agree with Raj. Quick plan: 1) pin model to prod variant, 2) re-run deploy checks, 3) schedule TTL and secret normalization for a maintenance window. I can push the pin now as a hotfix.

Maria Hu: ok, if someone can push the manifest change to pin model -> v2.2 I'll ask deploy-bot to re-run. This keeps prod behavior conservative.

Kevin O'Connor: pushing now: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/infer-worker model=redwood/ggml:v2.2 --record`

deploy-bot: re-run queued. Note: model binary hash differs between v2.4 and v2.2; warming KV cache may be required. Embedding checksum for prod v2.2: `sha256:1a2b3c4d...`.

Sam Lee: if we pin to prod variant, confirm dedicated pool routing won't break (we have routing overrides for v2.4). @Raj can you confirm routing compatibility?

Raj Patel: checking routing configs... ok, dedicated pools have fallback rules, routing will accept v2.2 for this canary. TTL change could spike cache misses; recommend doing TTL change in off-peak and add cache-warm job.

Maria Hu: thanks. If deploy passes I'll mark this as a minor rollback in the release notes and open a follow-up to standardize MODEL_ACCESS_SCOPE and TTLs. Filing INF-4721 and assigning to infra for secret normalization.

Kevin O'Connor: deploy-bot re-run succeeded ✅

deploy-bot: canary promotion complete. Checks passed. promotion_id=prom-3456789123. Release unpaused.

Maria Hu: noted. I'll add a short blurb in the changelog: "Canary pinned to prod model v2.2 to avoid secret/TTL drift; follow-up INF-4721 opened."

Sam Lee: thanks all — tagging infra to make sure the secret standardization plan is scoped. :thumbsup:
